statement.p: Compute the flux of the vector field \vec F = 3 x\vec i + 2 y\vec j through the cylindrical surface shown below, if a = 2 and b = 7 and it is oriented away from the z-axis.

static.solution: d\vec A = (2 \cos\theta\vec i + 2 \sin\theta\vec j) d\theta\, dz. Thus, with x = 2\cos\theta and y = 2\sin\theta, \int_S \vec F\cdot d\vec A = \int_0^{7}\int_0^{2\pi}(6 \cos\theta\vec i+ 4 \sin\theta\vec j)\cdot (2 \cos\theta\vec i+ 2 \sin\theta\vec j)\,d\theta\, dz = \int_0^{7}\int_0^{2\pi} 12\cos^2\theta + 8\sin^2\theta \,d\theta \,dz = 140 \pi.
